Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Environment › Conservation, environmental pollution and degradation, environmental impact assessment › Air pollution — GRAP, CAQM
CA Topic / Headline: Delhi winter pollution curbs kick in from Nov 1: non-Delhi non-BS-VI vehicles barred, no fuel without valid PUC; CPCB orders closure of NCR units that have not ordered APCDs within five days; CAQM PM limit 50 mg/Nm3 for 17 highly polluting categories.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• CAQM PM emission limit: 50 mg/Nm3 for 17 highly polluting industry categories, applicable from October 1.
• APCDs are filtration and emission-control systems fitted to industrial exhaust stacks; bag filters are one type.
• Delhi curbs: non-Delhi non-BS-VI vehicles barred from Nov 1 to Jan 31; no fuel without valid PUC certificate.
• Rain pulled Delhi average AQI down to 60 on Friday, per the IITM-maintained network.
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Issue] Several NCR units had not ordered new APCDs or obtained adequacy assessment reports, prompting CPCB closure directions.
• [Intro data] CPCB letter of October 30 asked Delhi PCC and Haryana, U.P., Rajasthan boards to issue show-cause notices.
• [Way forward] Pair vehicle curbs with continuous stack monitoring, time-bound APCD retrofits and region-wide enforcement across NCR States.
• [Counterpoint] Seasonal bans hurt gig workers and border traffic while year-round sources keep emitting.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Science & Technology › IT, space, computers, robotics, nanotechnology, biotechnology, intellectual property rights › NavIC — NVS series
CA Topic / Headline: GSLV-F18 places NVS-03 in orbit (apogee 38,080 km vs planned 37,247 km), restoring NavIC to its minimum four-satellite configuration; ISRO flew it with pyro valves pre-opened after the NVS-02 failure.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• NVS-03 launched on GSLV-F18 from Sriharikota on October 30.
• NavIC needs at least four satellites for standalone positioning; NVS-03 restored that minimum.
• NVS-03 has a 12-year mission life and adds the L1 band (V&R).
• Last atomic clock aboard IRNSS-1F stopped working in March.
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Issue] NVS-02 (2025) failed because the drive signal did not reach the oxidiser pyro valve.
• [Issue] Indigenous clocks face procurement challenges; ISRO proposes up to five clocks per satellite.
• [Way forward] Launch NVS-04 and NVS-05 quickly, mandate NavIC chipsets and build clock supply chains.
• [Intro data] Original IRNSS satellites were launched between 2013 and 2018.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Internal Security › Communication networks, media and social networking, cyber security, money-laundering › Content blocking — Sec 69A, 79(3)(b), IT Rules
CA Topic / Headline: MeitY advisories of October 8 and 10 amid anti-CEC protests drive a wave of post and account blocking on Meta and X; amended IT Rules cut takedown time to three hours from 36; users face 60-90 day grievance delays.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Section 69A, IT Act, 2000: Centre may block online content on sovereignty, security, public order grounds.
• Section 79(3)(b): safe-harbour can lapse if an intermediary fails to act on lawful notice.
• Rule 3(1)(d), IT Rules 2021: takedown within three hours of court order or authorised intimation.
• Grievance Appellate Committee hears appeals against platform grievance officers’ decisions.
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Issue] Platform-level removals under community standards leave users without constitutional-court remedy, per advocate Rishav Ranjan.
• [Intro data] Delhi Police issued about 300 takedown requests in three months, most acted upon (V&R).
• [Way forward] Publish reasoned orders, add notice and hearing, and set time-bound GAC review.
• [Counterpoint] Rapid removal limits deepfakes and incitement during volatile protests.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Economy › Infrastructure: energy, ports, roads, airports, railways › Ethanol blending — E20, E100, flex-fuel
CA Topic / Headline: MoRTH amends Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 to include E100 alongside E85, paving way for flex-fuel vehicle homologation; existing vehicles need not switch; India hit E20 in 2025, five years early.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• E100 is fuel with 100% ethanol; usable only in vehicles designed for it.
• India achieved E20 in 2025, five years ahead of the 2030 deadline under National Policy on Biofuels, 2018.
• From April 2026, all BS-VI vehicles must meet E20 emission standards.
• Homologation is official certification by agencies such as ARAI before type approval.
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Issue] Ethanol’s lower energy density lowers mileage; government estimates about 5% decline.
• [Issue] Large-scale ethanol needs land and water and competes with food crops.
• [Counterpoint] Experts warn blending distracts from electrification, a clearer path to deep emission cuts.
• [Way forward] Diversify to second-generation feedstock, track lifecycle emissions and build flex-fuel dispensing.
